question: Should this timeline view be scoped as a UI/CLI layer on top of the metadata-audit foundation, folded into the broader subagent lifecycle observability work, or declined as out of current core scope?
rationale: The source has useful primitives, but the public command shape, persistence owner, retention, authorization, and redaction semantics need maintainer product/security intent before implementation.

options.title: Build on metadata audit first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata foundation, then add the timeline CLI/chat/UI views as a bounded follow-up.

options.title: Fold into subagent lifecycle scope
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38626 as the owner for lifecycle events and keep this issue only for the view/export layer after that contract lands.

options.title: Decline new timeline surfaces
options.body: Keep the existing Activity tab and trajectory export as the supported observability surfaces and close this feature direction if maintainers do not want another timeline view.

recommendation.title: Build on metadata audit first
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98521 as the durable metadata foundation, then add the timeline CLI/chat/UI views as a bounded follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the related metadata-audit direction and appears in recent history for the current Activity/CLI command surfaces.
